description: This source file implements a benchmarking tool for measuring the performance of image resize algorithms using Skia's ImageOperations::Resize function. It generates bitmaps, applies resize methods, and reports throughput in MB/s.

classes.name: Dimensions
classes.description: Represents width and height of a bitmap, with validation and parsing from string.

classes.name: Benchmark
classes.description: Performs image resize performance benchmarking with configurable parameters.

classes.name: CommandLineAutoReset
classes.description: Manages initialization and cleanup of command line parsing to prevent leaks.

methods.name: Benchmark::ParseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to set benchmarking parameters.

methods.name: Benchmark::Run
methods.description: Executes the resize benchmark and reports throughput.

methods.name: Benchmark::Usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the benchmarking tool.
